title: A Hands-on Guide to Streaming Speech Recognition and Synthesis
description: For engineers starting out with streaming speech. It goes from audio as numbers, through how streaming speech recognition and synthesis models work, to measuring their accuracy, quality and latency, serving them, and the latency budget of a real-time voice agent. Every example is in English and Mandarin, with a CPU track and a GPU track, and every measured number names the result file it came from.
